name: Instagram Reels, TikTok and Podcast Transcripts
title: Instagram Reels & TikTok Transcript Scraper
uses: Creators and marketers studying the hooks and scripts of top Reels and TikToks
Turning short videos and podcast episodes into posts, notes and newsletters
RAG pipelines and datasets built from spoken social and podcast content
AI agents that need what a Reel, TikTok or audio file actually says, with timestamps

inputs.name: videoUrls
inputs.title: Video URLs
inputs.description: Instagram Reel/post links, TikTok video links (including vm.tiktok.com short links), direct audio/video file URLs (mp3, m4a, mp4, wav, webm, ogg), and podcast RSS feed URLs (the latest episodes are transcribed). An Instagram profile link is treated as a username.

inputs.name: instagramUsernames
inputs.title: Instagram usernames (optional)
inputs.description: Transcribe the most recent video posts and reels of public Instagram accounts. Best effort: Instagram returns up to about 12 recent posts without login.

inputs.name: maxReelsPerProfile
inputs.title: Max videos per Instagram profile
inputs.description: How many recent videos to take from each username. Without login Instagram only exposes the latest ~6 posts of a profile (photos are skipped), so you may get fewer.

inputs.name: maxEpisodesPerFeed
inputs.title: Max episodes per podcast feed
inputs.description: For podcast RSS feed URLs, how many of the newest episodes to transcribe.

inputs.name: speechToText
inputs.title: Speech-to-text
inputs.description: Instagram has no public captions, so Instagram transcripts always use speech-to-text unless this is Off.

inputs.name: sttModel
inputs.title: Speech-to-text model
inputs.description: Open-source Whisper models running inside the actor. Same price for both.

inputs.name: maxTranscribeSeconds
inputs.title: Max seconds to transcribe per video
inputs.description: Longer videos and episodes are transcribed up to this length and marked truncated: true. Up to 1800 seconds (30 minutes).

inputs.name: language
inputs.title: Language hint (optional)
inputs.description: ISO code like en, es, de. Leave empty to auto-detect. Also picks the matching TikTok caption track when several exist.

inputs.name: includeSegments
inputs.title: Include timestamped segments
inputs.description: Adds segments: [{start, end, text}] in seconds.

inputs.name: includeSrt
inputs.title: Include SRT subtitles
inputs.description: Adds the transcript as an SRT subtitle string.

inputs.name: speakerLabels
inputs.title: Speaker labels (who said what)
inputs.description: Detects the different voices and labels every segment Speaker 1, Speaker 2, ... Adds speakerTranscript (one line per speaker turn), speakerCount and talk time per speaker. No extra charge for the labels. They need the audio, so TikToks are then transcribed by AI speech-to-text (AI transcript price) instead of captions. Best for podcasts, interviews and multi-person videos.

inputs.name: numSpeakers
inputs.title: Number of speakers (optional)
inputs.description: Only used with speaker labels. Set it when you know how many people talk (for example 2 for an interview) for more accurate labels. 0 = detect automatically.

inputs.name: proxyConfiguration
inputs.title: Proxy
inputs.description: Optional. By default the actor connects directly and falls back to a built-in residential proxy when a platform blocks it.

description: Transcripts with timestamps for Instagram Reels, TikTok, podcast RSS feeds and any audio/video file URL (mp3, m4a, mp4, wav). Native TikTok captions first, built-in Whisper speech-to-text for the rest. Optional speaker labels (who said what). No login, no API key.
